llm.evidence: coupled online to a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
Label-free LC-MS/MS analysis allowed the quantitation of 4963 proteins
digested with sequencing grade trypsin (Promega, Madison, WI)
Mass spectrometry data were measured using a data-dependent top-15 method.
Selected ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell with normalised collision energy of 30%
reduced with 10 mM DTT for 1 h at 37 °C
then it was alkylated using 50 mM iodoacetamide for 30 min
